    c = d.get("cost")

    """Distribute partitions across the k cheapest simple paths per destination.

    Enumerate simple paths in increasing cost order and assign partitions
    round-robin over the best few. This spreads traffic over multiple
    networks/links, avoids overloading any single route, and minimizes
    total transfer cost. Robust to missing edge costs and unreachable dsts.
